comparison.objective: Fit an end bracket onto a loose DIN rail, push it flush to terminal blocks, and tighten its screw.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the rail, hook and seat a bracket on both lips, then use a screwdriver to clamp it.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket seated, flush within 0.5 mm, tightened to the target, stable; excess rail motion caps credit.
comparison.reason: This tests snap/seat geometry and screwdriver tightening. Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; there is no hammer impulse, intentional breakage, retained coil, or generated-fragment containment.
